stories.title: Nobelprijs voor Natuurkunde naar Belgische fysicus Francis Halzen, die ‘spookachtige’ deeltjes ving in het ijs van Antarctica

en.title: Nobel Prize in Physics awarded to Belgian physicist Francis Halzen, who caught 'ghostly' particles in Antarctic ice
en.summary: Belgian physicist Francis Halzen received the Nobel Prize in Physics for detecting elusive particles in Antarctic ice.

stories.title: 3 jaar na terreuraanval van Hamas keren inwoners terug, maar het trauma blijft

en.title: 3 years after Hamas terror attack, residents return, but trauma remains
en.summary: Most residents have returned to their homes in the Gaza border region three years after the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack, though psychological effects persist among the population.

stories.title: Voormalig hoofd Duitse inlichtingendienst BND opgepakt op verdenking van spionage en poging tot landverraad

en.title: Former head of German intelligence service BND arrested on suspicion of espionage and attempted treason
en.summary: August Hanning, former BND director who left the service in 2005, was arrested for allegedly possessing classified BND documents from 2022 and conducting security analysis for a foreign intelligence agency.

stories.title: Russische autoriteiten melden uitzonderlijk grote droneaanval op Moskou

en.title: Russian authorities report exceptionally large drone attack on Moscow
en.summary: Moscow was targeted by an unusually large attack involving 650 drones during the night of Monday to Tuesday, marking the second-largest such attack in two years according to Russian state media.

stories.title: Voormalige Duitse spionagechef aangehouden voor landverraad en spionage

en.title: Former German intelligence chief arrested for treason and espionage
en.summary: August Hanning, who headed Germany's BND intelligence agency from 1998 to 2005, has been arrested at age 80 on suspicion of espionage and treason.

stories.title: Voormalig chef Duitse inlichtingen opgepakt vanwege spionage

en.title: Former head of German intelligence arrested over espionage
en.summary: August Hanning, former director of Germany's BND intelligence service from 1998 to 2005, was arrested on suspicion of espionage, treason, and disclosing state secrets. He allegedly sold classified information to a BND employee until 2022 for use in security analysis for a foreign intelligence agency.

stories.title: Onvrede in Japan groeit na arrestatie Amerikaanse militair voor moord op vrouw

en.title: Discontent in Japan grows after arrest of American soldier for murder of woman
en.summary: A U.S. military serviceman was arrested for murdering a woman, sparking rising discontent among Japanese citizens about American military presence. Protests are occurring in Okinawa.

stories.title: Separatisten in Quebec winnen verkiezingen, dreun voor premier Carney

en.title: Separatists in Quebec win elections, setback for Premier Carney
en.summary: The separatist Parti Quebecois narrowly won local elections in Quebec, seeking independence from Canada, damaging Premier Mark Carney's position as Canada faces trade conflict with the United States.

stories.title: Grote Oekraïense droneaanval op regio Moskou, ook weer Oekraïense brug bestookt

en.title: Large Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow region, Ukrainian bridge also targeted again
en.summary: Ukraine launched at least 650 drones against Moscow and surrounding targets since yesterday evening, according to local officials. The attack resulted in at least two deaths and nine injuries across sixteen municipalities in the Moscow region, with damage reported to 47 residential buildings.

stories.title: Lek zeeschip in de Eemshaven gedicht, gevaar zinken afgewend

en.title: Leak in sea vessel at Eemshaven sealed, sinking danger averted
en.summary: Divers have sealed a leak in the Nautilus, a 73-by-16-meter cargo ship carrying offshore wind turbine components, preventing it from sinking in the Eemshaven.

stories.title: Nobelprijs voor geneeskunde naar optogenetica: een lichtknopje in de hersenen

en.title: Nobel Prize in Medicine awarded for optogenetics: a light switch in the brain
en.summary: A light-sensitive molecule discovered in algae was found to function as a control mechanism across different organisms, including potential applications in human brain research through the technique called optogenetics.

stories.title: Nobelprijs voor de Geneeskunde voor ‘optogenetica’, futuristische manier om hersencellen van buitenaf te besturen

en.title: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine awarded for 'optogenetics', futuristic method to control brain cells from outside
en.summary: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded for research in optogenetics, a technique that enables external control of brain cells.
